title: Whittaker functions with one or both parameters large: simplified uniform asymptotic expansions involving Bessel and Airy functions
summary: Uniform asymptotic expansions are derived as $κ\to \infty$ for the Whittaker functions $W_{κ,μ}(z)$, $M_{κ,μ}(z)$, as well as related functions including generalized Laguerre polynomials. The results are uniformly valid for $0\leqμ\leq(1-δ_0)κ<κ$, where $δ_0\in(0,1)$ is arbitrary and fixed. The analysis is based on the associated differential equation, which has a double pole and two turning points.
